title: GODsend 360 video guides
intro: Short screen recordings of the GODsend 360 desktop app: your Xbox library, the four download sources, the toolbox and settings. The demo data shown is fixture data, no real Xbox is involved.

sections.title: Your library
sections.summary: See what is on the console.

videos.title: Xbox Library
videos.description: Every game found on your Xbox through Aurora, as real box art you can flip: hover a cover and the case turns in 3D. Search, sort, filter, refresh from the console and fetch missing covers.
steps: Hover a cover to flip the case

videos.title: The game page
videos.description: Click a cover to open its page: publisher, developer and release date, the Aurora library entry, the Aurora assets (background, banner, icon, cover and screenshots, searched online or loaded from a file), DLC and title updates, and save games.

sections.title: Getting games
sections.summary: Find a game and send it to the console.

videos.title: Browse and Download
videos.description: One list over four sources: Minerva Archive over BitTorrent, Internet Archive, your own Transfer folder and dlxbgame releases. Filter by title and switch between Xbox 360, Original Xbox, XBLA, Digital, DLC and Indie.

videos.title: Toolbox
videos.description: Convert and move files: ISO to GOD, ISO to XEX, BadAvatar USB and an FTP manager for the console.

videos.title: ISO to GOD
videos.description: Convert Xbox 360 disc images to the Games on Demand format Aurora installs. Add ISOs, choose an output folder and convert; output is named Title Name - TitleID.

videos.title: ISO to XEX
videos.description: Extract a disc image to a folder with a default.xex so the game runs straight from that folder.

videos.title: BadAvatar USB
videos.description: Prepare a USB stick for the BadUpdate exploit: pick the drive, format it to FAT32, and add optional packages such as Proto, FreestyleDash and the Aurora XeUnshackle build.

videos.title: FTP Manager
videos.description: Browse the console drive over FTP: upload files or folders, make folders, cut, copy and paste, with transfer progress on the right.

videos.title: Job Queue
videos.description: Every download, conversion and FTP transfer in one list, with live status, progress and speed, and a cancel button for each job.

videos.title: Console
videos.description: The live terminal of the backend. Downloads, conversions and FTP transfers log here, and you can open the logs folder to share a log.

videos.title: Settings
videos.description: Choose folders, set the Xbox FTP connection, send the Aurora script to the console, export Aurora databases and refresh the dlxbgame list and caches.
